newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka June 97 M2 up 10.3 pct to 265.1 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka June 97 M2 up 10.3 pct to 265.1 bln rupees.

text.p: Sri Lanka's broad money supply, or M2, grew 10.3 percent year-on-year in June to 265.1 billion rupees from 240.4 billion in the same month last year, the Central Bank said on Monday.
The bank's weekly economic report said Sri Lanka's narrow money, or M1, mainly notes and coins in circulation, rose 4.9 percent year-on-year to 79.7 billion rupees, from 76 billion in June 1996.
